title: CharacterSourceDefinition
description: Authoritative schema for a character asset before baking. Defines what animations, directions, and frames exist. Frame image blobs are stored separately under stable logical keys derived from this schema: characters/{id}/frames/{animation}/{direction}/{frame}.png. The baker validates that every declared frame has a corresponding blob — missing blobs are hard errors.

id.description: Unique identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric + underscores. Used as the storage key prefix and body_def_id in the game runtime.

spriteSize.description: Width and height of each frame image in pixels. All frames must be this size.

frameDuration.description: Seconds per frame for animation playback.

weaponDefId.description: Optional reference to a weapon/object asset for melee equipment rendering.

throwableDefId.description: Optional reference to a weapon/object asset for ranged/throwable rendering.

animations.description: Map of animation name to per-direction frame declarations. Each animation can have independent frame counts per direction.

propertyNames.description: Animation name: idle, walk, melee_attack, throw_attack, or custom.

AnimationDirections.description: Per-direction frame counts for one animation. Each direction has an independent frame count.

frames.description: Number of frames for this animation+direction. Frame blobs are stored at indices 0..frames-1.

loop.description: Whether this animation loops or plays once and holds the last frame.
